name: Flow tracers
author: moran
description: About 30 evenly scattered tracers drift with the apparent motion of the rain (optical flow) and sing as they travel: more rain under a tracer plays a higher, louder note, faster motion sounds brighter, east/west pans left/right, and the voice changes with the world-orchestra region it passes. Hover or use the arrow keys to hear the local motion described, e.g. moving north-east, 30 km/h.
